title: Acid Vial
summary: Throw to deal 2d6 Acid and create an Acid surface.

fields.Damage: 2d6 Acid, negated by a DC 13 Dexterity save.
fields.Surface: 7 ft radius. Creatures standing in it have −2 AC.
fields.Base value: 16 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 mechanics and pinned item and related rule sources.
